newsitem.title: UK: British killer housewife to appeal to Europe court.
newsitem.headline: British killer housewife to appeal to Europe court.

text.p: British housewife Rosemary West, serving a life jail term for killing 10 young women and girls, is to take her case to the European Court of Human Rights, her lawyer said on Saturday.
Leo Goatley told reporters he would be making an application shortly to the European Commission of Human Rights on the grounds that West had not had a fair trial.
West, 42, was convicted in November last year after the bodies of nine of the women, including her own daughter, were found buried in her home, dubbed the "House of Horrors".
Her husband Fred, who was jointly charged with the gruesome killings hanged himself in jail while awaiting trial for what was one of Britain's most sensational murder cases.
"We have genuine concerns about the way the media conducted itself in the West case and the issue of the fairness of the trial remains," Goatley said.
He said the European Commission would consider West's application and it could then take anything up to five years before the case could eventually be heard.
Goatley said that, if the case is upheld, British law could be changed, enabling West to have a re-trial.
England's High Court has already turned down an appeal by Rosemary West on grounds of media coverage before the trial and the buying up by the media of prosecution witnesses.
West has always proclaimed her innocence of the murders that took place in her own home in Gloucester in southwestern England, over a 20-year period.

The prosecution in the trial said that together the Wests picked up girls and sexually tormented them before killing them, cutting up their bodies and burying them in their cellar or garden along with the ropes and masks that restrained them.

On Friday the local council in Gloucester said it planned to demolish the West's house and to stop ghoulish souvenir hunters, the bricks will be ground to dust, every floorboard burned and every fitting melted down.
